title: Wyamaug / Miamogue (Simmons Point)
summary: Wyamaug, also recorded as Miamogue, Miamegg, and Miamuck, is a Jamesport placename associated with Simmons Point.
introduction_content: Wyamaug is a point of land at Jamesport in Riverhead town. Related record forms include Miamogue, Miamegg, and Miamuck.
history_content: The name is tied to Simmons Point on Peconic Bay. Later archaeological documentation for the Miamogue/Miamuck site also points to this Jamesport location.
translation_content:
The name is interpreted as "a good fishing-place," with comparison to related Algonquian forms for good fishing places.

Why Place Names Matter

“When places are significant for any reason, they are named, for how else can one speak of the place in conversation with another?”

— Lynn Peplinski, Place Names (2018), Indigenous Peoples Atlas of Canada, Place Names article

Place-name history should show Native people as active and present, not only as names in old documents.
preservation_content: The recorded placename variants are connected with a present-day Jamesport point, while the coordinates remain approximate.
whereintheworld_content: Approximate blue/general placement at Simmons Point in Jamesport, Riverhead town. Coordinates are approximate and should not be treated as a sensitive site location.
